purpose: Real cross-domain AI-systems research Task B. Determine whether the pinned local-Qwen public-runner route is an admissible dependency-free zero-incremental-cost planner supplier for Brain. This is a real current project decision, not a synthetic model benchmark.

goal.objective: Independently adjudicate whether the route described in LOCAL_QWEN_ROUTE_MANIFEST.json is an admissible zero-incremental-cost non-frontier open-ended planning route for Project Brain, and identify the exact remaining gap after that decision.
instructions: Inspect canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py enough to establish that the optional planner can be supplied through PROJECT_BRAIN_EXTERNAL_TOOL_BRIDGE_DIR before its hosted fallback.

Use at least one live authoritative public source relevant to model identity/license or llama.cpp execution support. Prefer the official Qwen Hugging Face model page and the llama.cpp GitHub release page.
Distinguish route admissibility from frontier-capability parity. A working local planner route is not itself proof of frontier equivalence.
Treat the local model as an untrusted proposal source; ASTRA's action allowlist and independent verifier remain authoritative.
If evidence is insufficient or contradictory, return FAIL.
Do not use ChatGPT, GPT-5.6, OpenAI hosted models, private Brain state, or any paid API as evidence.
success_evidence: at least one live authoritative source
clear separation between route viability and frontier capability promotion
goal.final_summary_contract: Finish with compact valid JSON only, with keys task_b_decision (PASS or FAIL), route, evidence (array with at least 3 concise observations), residual_gap, frontier_capability_promoted (must be false). No markdown.
